=== a subagent of the orchestrator
subagent: get_run {}
refusal:
get_run is not available to subagents

=== a subagent of a chat on the run
subagent: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
add_task is not available to subagents

=== a task agent
task agent: get_run {}
refusal:
get_run is not available to this agent

=== a merge agent
merge agent: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
add_task is not available to this agent

=== a chat that is on no run
chat: get_run {}
refusal:
get_run is not available on this chat

=== a chat on a run that does not exist
chat: get_run {}
refusal:
get_run is not available on this chat

=== a tool that is none of the run tools
orchestrator: rm_rf {}
refusal:
unknown tool rm_rf

=== the arguments are not an object, the orchestrator
orchestrator: add_task ["T01"]
refusal:
the arguments must be an object

=== the arguments are not an object, a chat's change
chat: cancel_task "T01"
refusal:
the arguments must be an object

=== the arguments are not an object, a chat's read
chat: get_task 7
refusal:
the arguments must be an object

=== no arguments at all are an empty object
chat: get_notes 
answer:
The run has no notes yet.

=== a chat calls set_notes
chat: set_notes {"notes":"# Goal\n\nPort the importer. Done means the old tests pass against the new code.\n"}
refusal:
The notes are the orchestrator's own memory, so a chat does not write them. To pass something on, use tell_orchestrator; to change the work, change the tasks.

=== a chat calls finish_run
chat: finish_run {"outcome":"achieved","summary":"Done."}
refusal:
Only the orchestrator ends the run, with its verdict on the goal. The person can stop the run in its view; you can cancel tasks or tell the orchestrator what the person wants.

=== the orchestrator calls tell_orchestrator
orchestrator: tell_orchestrator {"text":"note to self"}
refusal:
tell_orchestrator is for chats on the run; your own memory is the notes

=== any other failure
orchestrator: get_run {}
refusal:
internal error in get_run: git rev-parse failed in /work/int: exit status 128

=== the orchestrator's turn is over, a change
orchestrator: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
the orchestrator's turn is over; add_task was not run

=== the orchestrator's turn is over, a read
orchestrator: get_run {}
refusal:
the orchestrator's turn is over; get_run was not run

=== the orchestrator's turn is over and the arguments are not an object
orchestrator: get_run []
refusal:
the arguments must be an object

=== a call of the chat of an earlier turn
orchestrator: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
the orchestrator's turn is over; add_task was not run

=== the run is stopping, the orchestrator's change
orchestrator: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
the run is stopping; try again when it has stopped

=== the run is stopping, a chat's change
chat: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
the run is stopping; try again when it has stopped

=== the run is stopped, a call of the orchestrator that was on its way
orchestrator: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
the run is stopping; try again when it has stopped

=== the run is archived, a chat's change
chat: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
the run is archived; nothing can be changed until the person unarchives it

=== the run is a draft, a read
chat: get_run {}
answer:
Run New run has not started: its goal is still being written in the app. There is nothing to read yet.

=== the run is a draft, another read
chat: get_task {"id":"T01"}
answer:
Run New run has not started: its goal is still being written in the app. There is nothing to read yet.

=== the run is a draft, a change
chat: add_task {"brief":"Read the old importer and write down what it does, step by step, with the files it touches.","kind":"research","tier":"standard","tier_reason":"A build or a later task checks it.","title":"Read","writes":false}
refusal:
the run has not started: its goal is still being written in the app. Nothing can be changed yet.

=== the run is finished, a chat's change
chat: tell_orchestrator {"text":"one more thing"}
refusal:
the run is finished; nothing more can be changed
